research.searchCoverage: Bounded review on 2026-09-13 of official Instatus Help API, OpenAPI spec, company identity (Instatus, Inc., Beaverton, Oregon / Delaware), and targeted incident/breach searches. No confirmed unresolved Instatus platform compromise was identified in reviewed coverage; this is not a breach-free claim.

Official Instatus API base URL https://api.instatus.com, Bearer authentication, GET /v2/pages, GET /v2/:page_id/components, GET /v1/:page_id/incidents, and GET /v1/user were confirmed on 2026-09-13 from Help pages. Independent unauthenticated probes the same day showed Help GET /v2/:page_id/components as a live route (HTTP 401 JSON) and pinned source GET /v2/pages/{pageId}/components as missing (HTTP 404 Cannot GET). OpenAPI GET /v1/{page_id}/components also exists as a live route (HTTP 401 JSON) but GET is aligned to Help v2. Instatus, Inc. is a US-incorporated international status-page product (Beaverton, Oregon / Delaware). Targeted searches for Instatus security breach/incident/data leak on 2026-09-13 found operational status-page events, not a confirmed unresolved platform compromise. Bounded coverage is not a breach-free claim.
research.waiverAuthority: User waiver dated 2026-09-13 permits historical non-China incident coverage.
